descriptions.zh:
宇宙中充满了生命。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，但那里还有其他什么？

我们与[capital_scope.GetName]上的野生动物的密切关系可能不适合星系尺度。辽阔的太空代表着一个全新的生态系统，我们发现自己站在十字路口。

这些生物对我们来说是什么？

无论我们做出什么选择，其后果都将在未来几年内显现。
descriptions.en:
The void is full of life. We have discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], but what else is out there?

Our close relationship with the wildlife on [capital_scope.GetName] may not be appropriate on the galactic scale. The void of space represents an entirely new ecosystem, and we find ourselves at a crossroads.

What are these creatures to us?

Whatever choice we make, the consequences will be felt for years to come.

descriptions.zh: 宇宙中可能充满了生命——我们有权消灭它们，或利用它们。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，并渴望找到更多。新鲜的猎物或役畜，选择权在我们手中。
descriptions.en: The void may well be full of life - ours to extinguish, or to use. Having discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we are eager to find more. Fresh prey or beasts of burden, the choice is up to us.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地学会了如何尊重当地§Y泰坦巨兽§!自然领地的边界。

随着我们的边界扩张和土地开发，这些巨大野兽将继续为我们的殖民地带来好处。
descriptions.en:
Our colony on [Root.GetName] has learned to respect the boundaries of the native §YTitanic Life§!'s natural territory.

These massive beasts will be a continued benefit to our settlement as we expand borders and develop the land.

descriptions.zh:
与[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]建立联系后，我们在[fromfrom.GetName]中发现了一具他们物种的腐烂尸体。遗骸在长时间暴露于太空后变得干枯并冻得梆硬。

我们推测这具尸体是吸引了该物种其他成员的首要因素；也许他们一直在寻找他们[from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]中失踪的成员。这是一个难得的机会，可以研究在虚空中自然死亡的[from.GetSpaceFaunaName]的生物学特性。
descriptions.en:
After establishing contact with the [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we detected a decaying corpse of one of their kind in [fromfrom.GetName]. The remains are withered and frozen after prolonged exposure to open space.

We postulate that this carcass is what initially attracted other members of their species; perhaps they had been searching for a lost member of their [from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]. This is a rare opportunity to study the biology of a [from.GetSpaceFaunaName] that has died of natural causes in the void.

descriptions.zh: 对[contact_system.GetName]的[met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName]尸体所进行的尸检已经完成。我们从遗骸中提取了一个保存完好的生物样本，它为我们提供了对其生理结构的独特见解。
descriptions.en: The autopsy on the [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] corpse in [contact_system.GetName] is complete. We have recovered a well-preserved biological specimen from within the remains that provides unique insight into their physiology.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一艘来自[from.GetName]的奇怪改装太空船取得了联系。这艘船装饰着成年的缇扬奇卷须，一排排虚空虫的牙齿，以及一个我们从未见过的生物的头骨。它配备了各种精密武器，显得杀气腾腾。

在天真地接受了我们的谈判邀请后，这位驾驶员被立即[GetExecuted]。我们已经夺取了他的古怪飞船，并将其加入了我们的军事序列。我们在他的个人物品中发现了一本有用的猎人工具指南。
descriptions.en:
We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. The ship is adorned with tendrils of mature Tiyanki, rows of Voidworm teeth, and the skull of a creature we have never seen before. It is bristling with an array of precision weapons.

After naively accepting our invitation to parlay, the pilot was summarily [GetExecuted]. We have claimed their peculiar ship and added it to our military ranks. We have discovered a useful hunter's field guide among their personal effects.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了来自[from.GetName]的一艘奇怪改装的星际飞船的联络。这艘船装饰着成年的缇扬奇卷须，一排排虚空虫的牙齿，以及一个我们从未见过的生物的头骨。它配备了各种精密武器，显得杀气腾腾。

他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。
descriptions.en:
We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. The ship is adorned with tendrils of mature Tiyanki, rows of Voidworm teeth, and the skull of a creature we have never seen before. It is bristling with an array of precision weapons.

They are hailing us on all frequencies.

descriptions.zh:
§H瑟里兹低沉的声音干涩而沙哑，仿佛已经好几周没有说话了。此人直言不讳，保持着冷静的眼神接触，既显得尊重，又让人感到一丝威慑。§!

作为一名猎物收藏家，要让我印象深刻可不容易。你们做到了。

我愿意加入你们的狩猎队伍，但前提是我们的合作将基于便利和相互学习。
descriptions.en:
§HThe brooding Ceriz's voice is dry and cracking, as if they had not spoken in weeks. Their manner is direct and they maintain stoic eye contact in a manner that feels in equal part respectful and intimidating.§!

As a trophy hunter, it takes a lot to impress me. Your people have.

I am willing to join your hunting parties with the understanding that our partnership will be one of convenience and mutual instruction.

descriptions.zh:
一艘独立的星际研究船联系了我们位于[from.GetName]的恒星基地。这艘船配备了一系列捕获装置和分析工具，专门用于捕获和研究太空生物。

他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。
descriptions.en:
We have been contacted by an independent research vessel at our starbase in [from.GetName]. Outfitted with an array of snaring devices and analytical tools, this ship is specifically adapted for the capture and examination of spaceborne life.

They are hailing us on all frequencies.

descriptions.zh:
§H茹克的眼睛不停地闪烁，注视着一个小巧的手持设备，她那探究和分析的目光让人印象深刻。即使在向我们打招呼时，她也似乎在做着笔记。尽管如此，她的态度还是友好而专业，只是略带疏离。§!

我发现自己对太空生物的兴趣并非孤例。我研究了[root.GetName]正在进行的研究，它简直是启迪人心。我非常希望能加入你们的科学部门，为这些努力贡献力量。当然，如果你们愿意的话。
descriptions.en:
§HInquisitive and analytical, Ruuk's eyes flicker constantly to a small, handheld device. Even as she greets us, she appears to be taking notes. Despite that, her manner is cordial and professional, if slightly detached.§!

I see that I'm not alone in my interest in spaceborne creatures. I have studied the research the [root.GetName] has been conducting and it is positively illuminating. I would love nothing more than to aid these efforts as part of your science department. If you'll have me, of course.

descriptions.zh:
我们探测到来自未知空间的大量古怪电磁波。

初步分析表明，这些波动与§Y虚空虫§!的通讯信号相似，但更加不规则，振幅也高得多。我们将对此进行进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a huge number of peculiar electromagnetic waves coming from uncharted space.

Initial analysis indicates a resemblance to §YVoidworm§! communication signals, albeit more irregular and with a greatly elevated amplitude. This will be investigated further.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经探测到这些动物般的尖叫声的来源：一个隐藏的恒星系，里面住满了§Y虚空虫§!，位于[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]附近。

这个恒星系中的虚空虫与我们之前遇到的不同。这些生物发生了变异；没有形成三头虫，单个成熟的个体正在进行的行为，只能被描述为狂暴的交配狂欢。

这令人担忧：这种非寄生行为意味着这个虫群可以独立繁殖，无需行星宿主。
descriptions.en:
We have detected the source of these animalistic screeches; a hidden system populated by §YVoidworm§! near [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName].

The Voidworms in this system are unlike those we have encountered previously. These creatures are mutated; there are no troikas formed and the individual mature specimens are engaging in what can only be described as a violent mating frenzy.

This is concerning: this non-parasitic behavior means this hive can breed independently without the need for planet-borne hosts.

descriptions.zh: 如果任由这种变异物种不受控制地蔓延，它可能会彻底破坏星系生态系统的平衡。根据它们不断升级的侵略行为，我们认为这些生物正在准备对[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]发动攻击。
descriptions.en: If this variant species were allowed to spread unchecked, it could upset the balance of the galactic ecosystem entirely. Based on their mounting aggression, we believe that these creatures are preparing for an assault on [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们必须准备好自己的防线。
descriptions.en: We must prepare our defenses.

descriptions.zh:
我们不愿坐等它们迟早要来的攻击，因此对变异的虚空虫在其家园星系发起了一场成功的军事行动。这些生物的威胁将不再笼罩[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]，我们星球的安全得到了保障。

我们保存了这些奇特变异体的巢穴中最大的那一个。在我们的控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而无需担心它们在星系中不受控制地蔓延。
descriptions.en:
Unwilling to wait for their inevitable attack, we launched a successful military campaign against the mutated Voidworms in their home system. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName], and the safety of our planet has been secured.

The largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
在消灭了巢穴附近的一窝虚空虫之后，我们发现这些生物发生了独特的变异。

它们似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖，并且处于高度攻击状态，这解释了它们非自然的强大和耐久性。

幸运的是，我们保留了一个它们的巢穴作为战利品。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。
descriptions.en:
After eliminating a clutch of Voidworms near their nests, we discovered that these creatures had undergone a unique mutation.

It seems that they were able to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner and were in a heightened state of aggression, which would explain their unnatural strength and durability.

Fortunately, we preserved one of their nests as a trophy. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经得知，威胁我们殖民地的变异虚空虫已被消灭。

这是一个意外但令人欣慰的结果。我们可以安心的是，这些生物将不再对我们的恒星系构成威胁。
descriptions.en:
We have learned that the mutated Voidworms threatening our colony have been eliminated.

An unexpected, but welcome conclusion. We can take solace in the fact that these creatures shall no longer antagonize our systems.

descriptions.zh:
狂暴的虚空虫正在攻击[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]！

它们的侵略性已经达到顶峰，目前它们的主虫群正在直奔[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]而去。

我们认为它们不会留下任何幸存者。
descriptions.en:
The frenzied Voidworms are attacking [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]!

Their aggression has risen to a fever pitch, and the current trajectory of their main swarm is heading directly for [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

We do not believe they intend on leaving any survivors.

options.script: name = grand_archive.1200.a

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大努力，变异的虚空虫还是彻底摧毁了[this.GetName]。这些狂暴生物的对地轰击太过猛烈，导致行星地核破裂，整个星球最终裂成碎片。没有幸存者。

它们已经回到了巢穴，不再对我们的存在感到激怒。希望它们能一直待在那里。

我们主巢的陷落对于[event_target:victim_country.GetName]来说是一次重大的打击，但我们必须学会接受。
descriptions.en:
Despite our best efforts, the mutated Voidworms have completely overwhelmed [this.GetName]. The frenzied creatures' bombardment was so violent that it cracked the planet's core, causing it to fragment and break apart. There were no survivors.

They have since returned to their nests and are no longer agitated by our presence. With any luck, they will remain there.

The loss of our primary hive is a blow to [event_target:victim_country.GetName], but we live on.

We have no recourse in the face of this tragedy except to live on and learn from our mistakes.

label.en: Now is the time to rebuild.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]发现的变异虚空虫已被消灭。[avenged_homeworld.GetName]的毁灭得到了报复。

我们保留了这些奇怪变异生物的巢穴中最大的那一个。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒着它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。

这样，我们一度失去的世界依旧能够传承下来。
descriptions.en:
The mutated Voidworms discovered in [From.GetName] have been eliminated. The destruction of [avenged_homeworld.GetName] has been avenged.

The largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

In this way, the legacy of our lost world will live on.

descriptions.zh:
通过向[frenzied_home_system.GetName]的变异虚空虫巢穴直接输送大量矿物，我们成功地与它们建立了联系。这些生物的威胁将不再笼罩[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]。我们星球的安全得到了保障。

我们经验最丰富的动物饲养员一直在努力管理这些野兽，现在它们似乎愿意同我们进行互相合作。

我们已经收容了它们最大的巢穴之一。有了它，我们可以培育更多这些原本会留在野外的变异虚空虫。
descriptions.en:
After sending significant amounts of mineral sustenance directly to their nests, we were able to develop a relationship with the mutated Voidworms in [frenzied_home_system.GetName]. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]. The safety of our planet has been secured.

Our most experienced animal handlers have been at work managing the beasts, and we are at a point where they seem to be willing to mutually cooperate.

We have taken in one of their largest nests. With this, we can cultivate more of these mutated Voidworms that would otherwise have been left to the wild.

descriptions.zh:
通过向[frenzied_home_system.GetName]的变异虚空虫巢穴直接输送大量矿物，我们成功地与它们建立了联系。这些生物的威胁将不再笼罩[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]。我们星球的安全和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。

我们经验最丰富的动物饲养员一直在努力管理这些野兽，现在它们似乎愿意同我们进行互相合作。

我们已经收容了它们最大的巢穴之一。有了它，我们可以培育更多这些原本会留在野外的变异虚空虫。
descriptions.en:
After sending significant amounts of mineral sustenance directly to their nests, we were able to develop a relationship with the mutated Voidworms in [frenzied_home_system.GetName]. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]. The safety of our planet and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.

Our most experienced animal handlers have been at work managing the beasts, and we are at a point where they seem to be willing to mutually cooperate.

We have taken in one of their largest nests. With this, we can cultivate more of these mutated Voidworms that would otherwise have been left to the wild.

label.zh: 对于舰队来说是备受欢迎的补充。
label.en: A welcome addition to the fleets.

tooltips.zh: 所有狂暴的虚空虫舰队都将由你的帝国控制
tooltips.en: All Frenzied Voidworm fleets are added to your empire's control

descriptions.zh: 我们对[this.GetHomeWorldName]发现的远古胶囊有了新的发现。得益于我们[this.GetScientistPlural]孜孜不倦的工作，现在将要完成解密数字密保的最后一层，破译令我们着迷已久的图表。
descriptions.en: We have made a breakthrough regarding the Ancient Capsule found orbiting [this.GetHomeWorldName]. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our [this.GetScientistPlural], we are now in a position to decrypt the final layer of digital security and decipher the chart that has intrigued us for so long.

descriptions.zh:
这张海图并不完整！

轨道胶囊内的数据支离破碎，每一个明显的缺口都像是拼图中缺失的一块。尽管如此，它还是揭示了一个以前未知的恒星系坐标，然而关于在那里等待着我们的是什么并没有提供任何细节。

该海图还突出了一系列用来进行超空间航行到达该目的地的突破点。
descriptions.en:
The chart is only partially complete!

The data within the orbital capsule is fragmented, each conspicuous gap like the missing piece of a puzzle. Nevertheless, it reveals the coordinates of a previously-unknown star system, but does not provide any detail as to what awaits us there.

The chart also highlights a series of established breach points to facilitate hyperlane travel to the destination.

descriptions.zh:
在胶囊里发现的星图吸引了全社会的注意。现在证明这不过是整张星图的冰山一角，不知道它将会把我们带向何处、找到什么。我们决定要完成这份《§Y星国图志§!》。

我们的舰队蓄势待发，准备踏上我们文明的下一段征途。
descriptions.en:
The discovery of the chart inside of the capsule has captured the attention of our society. Now that it has been revealed to be a piece among many, we wonder where it may lead and what we might find there. We are determined to complete this "§YCelestial Chart§!".

Our ships are standing by, eager to set forth on our civilization's next great adventure.

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetHomeWorldName]的人口沉迷于最近解密的星图。人们叫它《§Y星国图志§!》，它目前带来的更多是疑问而非答案。它从何而来？是由谁出于什么目的撰写？而且或许最重要的是——这会把我们带向陷阱吗？

我们的舰队蓄势待发，准备踏上我们文明的下一段征途。
descriptions.en:
The population of [this.GetHomeWorldName] is enthralled with the recently deciphered star chart. Commonly referred to as the "§YCelestial Chart§!", so far it provides more questions than answers. Where did it come from? Who created it, and for what purpose? And perhaps most importantly - will it lead us into a trap?

Our ships are standing by, eager to set forth on our civilization's next great adventure.

descriptions.zh:
我们遇到了一支悬挂不明旗帜的、全副武装的舰队。他们的船只列阵整齐，但设计五花八门。许多都配备了动能发射器，连接着挂碳钢钩和鱼叉的粗缆线。此外，在舰队中央还有一组装甲输送车。我们只能猜测这些船只是由一群海盗或雇佣兵控制的。

我们收到了他们领头船发来的信号。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered a heavily-armed fleet flying under an unknown flag. Their ships are in organized formation but not uniform in their design. Many are outfitted with kinetic launchers attached to reels of thick cable tipped with carbon steel hooks and harpoons. Additionally, there is a group of armored haulers sheltered in the center of the fleet. We can only surmise that these ships are controlled by a group of pirates or mercenaries.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

titles.en: Captain Hoo of the Black Needle

descriptions.zh:
§H这位不法之徒的首领高傲而冷淡，装出一副漫不经心的样子。他说话时低头看着自己的喙，拒绝与我们对视，仿佛我们不值得他全神贯注。他用羽毛做着无意间滑稽的动作。§!

你已经冒犯了§Y黑针§!，你惹上麻烦了！

我们听说你这新兴的小社会将探索这个恒星系。你偶然发现了一张明显属于我们的星图。交出来，否则别怪我们不客气。
descriptions.en:
§HDistinguished and haughty, this outlaw captain feigns disinterest. He looks down his beak when speaking and refuses to meet our gaze, as if we are unworthy of his full attention. He gesticulates with his feathers in an inadvertently comical manner.§!

You have crossed the path of the §YBlack Needle§!, a blunder on your part!

We caught wind of a rumor that your burgeoning little society would be exploring this system. You have stumbled upon a chart that clearly belongs to us. Hand it over, lest things become violent.

label.zh: 关于这星图你们有什么头绪？
label.en: What do you know of the chart?

label.zh: 你们为什么这么想要这个星图？
label.en: Why do you want this chart so badly?

label.zh: 我们是不会交出星图的。
label.en: We will be keeping our chart.

titles.en: Captain Hoo of the Black Needle

descriptions.zh:
你侮辱我就罢了，你还侮辱§Y黑针§!！这忍不了，一点也忍不了！

你拒绝合作的态度我们会记着的。黑针会用一切手段来结训你。我们易怒之下就能把你那小小的初生文明给弄死。

不交出那张星图我们是不会罢休的！今天就先放你们一马！
descriptions.en:
You have made a mockery of myself and the §YBlack Needle§!. This will not stand, not at all!

Your unwillingness to cooperate will not soon be forgotten. The Black Needle will come at you with all that we have. Your fledgling civilization will not survive our wrath.

We will not stop until that chart is ours! And now I shall bid you good day!

label.en: Next time, talk less and fight more!

descriptions.zh:
我们从漂浮的行星碎片中提取出了一个胶囊和一些矿物。打开以后，我们发现了另一块§Y星国图志§!的碎片，以及一些独特的文物。此外，在里面发现了一张字条，为了便于翻译它还使用了多种语言撰写。

“这里是索罗佩格玛的最后废墟，乙特人母星。乙特人是一个前超光速物种，由于一场悲惨的事故而灭绝。我们没有意识到即将到来的后果，意外触发了被盗巨像的破坏力量。请保护和尊重他们的记忆。”
descriptions.en:
A capsule was successfully extracted from the drifting planetary debris alongside a quantity of minerals. Upon opening it, we discovered a new piece of the §YCelestial Chart§! and a selection of unique cultural artifacts. Additionally, a note was found inside, written in multiple languages to allow for easier translation.

"This is all that remains of Soropegma, the Ytterite homeworld. The Ytterite were a Pre-FTL species rendered extinct as a result of a tragic accident. Unaware of the impending consequences, we accidentally triggered the destructive power of a stolen Colossus. Please preserve and respect their memory."

descriptions.zh: 突破多层加密后，新数据被无缝地添加到§Y星国图志§!中。当所有碎片拼凑完成，一个全新的星系跃然眼前。我们旅程的下一步近在咫尺，应该谨慎地去探索这片未测绘的太空区域。
descriptions.en: After breaking multiple layers of encryption, the new data was added seamlessly to the §YCelestial Chart§!. Once the pieces were combined, yet another new system was revealed. The next step of our journey lies before us. We should approach this uncharted area of space with caution.

descriptions.zh:
获得§Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!后，我们的科学家认为它应该在§Y博物天枢§!的公开展示区拥有一席之地。这座建筑将容纳我们不断壮大的珍稀文物收藏，这些文物将带来重大的文化和科学回报。我们将启动一项天使投资，用于保存和展示星系多样化和脆弱标本所需的技术的研发。

此外，在乙特人文物旁还发现了一份蓝图，其中包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
descriptions.en:
Following the acquisition of the §Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!, our scientists believe that it deserves to be placed on public display in the context of a §YGrand Archive§!. This structure would house our budding collection of rare artifacts which will reap significant cultural and scientific returns. An early-stage investment would kickstart the research into the techniques and technologies required to preserve and display the galaxy's diverse and delicate specimens.

Additionally, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact was discovered containing an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the archive in general.

options.script: name = grand_archive.4006.b

descriptions.zh:
失落的乙特文明的最后遗迹值得单独展出。

幸运的是，在乙特文物旁边发现的一份蓝图包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
descriptions.en:
The final trace of the lost Ytterite civilization merits its own exhibition.

Fortunately, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact contains an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the Archive in general.

descriptions.zh:
经过对乙特蓝图的仔细分析，我们建造了一个先进的收纳单元，其大气监测精度可达原子级别。这将使策展员能够高度详细地监控珍贵乙特人标本的大气条件，并检测任何潜在腐烂的预警信号。它将永远保持原样。

我们可以将这些技术应用于进一步改善我们收藏中所有物品的储存条件。
descriptions.en:
After careful analysis of the Ytterite blueprint, we have constructed an advanced containment unit with precise atmospheric monitoring down to the atom. This would allow curators to monitor the atmospheric conditions of the delicate Ytterite specimen on a highly detailed level and detect any warning signs of potential decay. It will be just as it was, forever.

We can apply these techniques to further improve the storage conditions of every item in our collection.

descriptions.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]的§Y博物天枢§!开张仪式是一个值得全体[this.GetName]庆祝的日子。这场来自全星系的珍宝展览激励着人们的探索精神，也呼唤着我们从过去汲取经验。
descriptions.en: The opening of the §YGrand Archive§! in [fromfrom.GetName] is a great day for the [this.GetName]. This exhibition of treasures from across the galaxy inspires exploration and calls us to learn from the past.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个带有§Y黑针§!标志的秘密地下基地。我们认为这是一个海盗集团的外部基地，与他们的其他行动隔离开来。§Y星国图志§!的下一部分一定存放在这里，很可能与其他财富和装饰品一起。

我们可以轻松地对基地进行轨道轰炸，但这可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。另一方面，快速部署地面部队将更快地夺取基地，杀他们个措手不及。

更隐秘的方法是入侵基地的计算机系统，直接大胆地抢走星国图志的那一部分。
descriptions.en:
We have found a covert underground base on [From.GetName] bearing the insignia of the §YBlack Needle§!. We believe that this is an external base used by the piracy group, isolated from their other operations. The next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§! must be stored here, likely alongside other riches and baubles.

We could easily begin orbital bombardment of the base, but this may give the Black Needle the time they need to call for reinforcements. On the other hand, a rapid deployment of our ground forces would more swiftly seize the base, giving little time for the enemy to respond.

A more clandestine approach would be to hack into the base's computer systems and secure the Celestial Chart piece in a daring heist.

descriptions.zh:
不出所料，黑针派出了一支舰队来保护他们在[FromFrom.GetName]的基地。

我们需要干掉这些舰船才能拿下[FromFrom.System.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
As expected, the Black Needle has sent a fleet to protect their base on [FromFrom.GetName].

We'll need to deal with these ships in order to secure [FromFrom.System.GetName].

options.script: name = VERYWELL

descriptions.zh: 经过轨道弹药的猛烈攻击，海盗基地最终连同其之前的居民被一起夷为了平地。所有威胁都被消除，现在我们可以派出一名科学官去探索废墟基地，并发掘下一块§Y星国图志§!。
descriptions.en: After battering the pirate base with orbital munitions, it has finally been reduced to rubble along with its previous inhabitants. With all threats neutralized, we can now send in a Scientist to explore the ruined base and extract the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

tooltips.zh: 黑针基地已被摧毁。§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!可以进行自由探索。
tooltips.en: The Black Needle base has been destroyed. §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! is free to be explored.

tooltips.zh: 黑针基地已被摧毁。§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!可以进行自由探索。
tooltips.en: The Black Needle base has been destroyed. §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! is free to be explored.

descriptions.zh: 我方地面部队已攻占了§Y黑针§!基地，目前正在清剿建筑物及其周围资源。所有威胁已消除，我们可以派遣一名科学家发掘下一块§Y星国图志§!碎片。
descriptions.en: Our ground forces have taken the §YBlack Needle§! base and are currently securing the building and its surrounding resources. With all threats neutralized, we can send in a Scientist to extract the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

tooltips.zh: 黑针的地面势力已经被清除。§Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§!可以进行自由探索。
tooltips.en: The Black Needle ground forces have been neutralized. §Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§! is now free to be explored.

tooltips.zh: 黑针的地面势力已经被清除。§Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§!可以进行自由探索。
tooltips.en: The Black Needle ground forces have been neutralized. §Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§! is now free to be explored.

descriptions.zh: 经过数月的准备，科学家[Leader.GetName]成功潜入了通讯网络，并伪装成了一艘§Y黑针§!飞船。在伪造的荷仁船长命令下，[Leader.GetHeShe]欺骗了基地操作员，让他们准备将星图胶囊进行紧急星际转移。
descriptions.en: After months of preparation, Scientist [Leader.GetName] successfully infiltrated the communications network and impersonated a §YBlack Needle§! vessel. Under fabricated orders from Captain Hoo, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] tricked the base operators into preparing the capsule for emergency off-world transfer.

descriptions.zh: 通过灵压，[Leader.GetName]轻易地便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
descriptions.en: Through psionic coercion, [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] easily able to manipulate the inferior minds of the guards to avoid further suspicions.

descriptions.zh: [Leader.Species.GetHandName]轻轻一挥，科学家[Leader.GetName]便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
descriptions.en: With a simple flick of the [Leader.Species.GetHandName], Scientist [Leader.GetName] manipulated the minds of the guards to allay any suspicions.

descriptions.zh: 凭借他们的魅力，科学家[Leader.GetName]能够避开任何棘手的问题。
descriptions.en: Using their charisma and charm, Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] able to avoid any difficult questions.

descriptions.zh: 科学家[Leader.GetName]将飞船降落一个绝佳位置，以便在掩护被揭穿的情况下迅速撤退。
descriptions.en: Scientist [Leader.GetName] landed their vessel in perfect position to make a hasty retreat in case their cover was blown.

descriptions.zh: 我们成功夺得胶囊，无人员伤亡。海盗们还没有意识到他们被骗了。
descriptions.en: The capsule was secured with no casualties. The pirates have not yet understood that they were duped.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是，在我们把胶囊装上飞船时，一名警卫发现了我们的计划。这一发现导致了一场短暂的枪战，我们被迫带着珍贵的货物逃离现场。胶囊成功提取，但科学家[Leader.GetName]在交火中丧生。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately, one of the guards caught on to our scheme as we were loading the capsule onto the ship. The discovery led to a short firefight, as we were forced to flee the scene with the precious cargo in tow. The capsule was successfully extracted, but Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] killed in the crossfire.

descriptions.zh:
我们在惊险逃脱§Y黑针§!据点后，我们的渗透行动已被完全发现。

由于这些漏洞暴露，海盗决定放弃他们在[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]上的基地，立即撤离并保护在那里储存的其他贵重物品。这颗可居住的卫星现在无人居住，可以被殖民。
descriptions.en:
Following our narrow escape from the §YBlack Needle§! stronghold, the full extent of our infiltration efforts has been discovered.

With these vulnerabilities exposed, the pirates decided to abandon their base on [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], evacuating immediately and securing the other valuables that were stored there. This habitable moon is now unoccupied and can be colonized.

descriptions.zh:
§Y黑针§!终于意识到自己被骗了，发现了他们封闭的安全网络中的漏洞。

由于这些漏洞暴露，海盗决定放弃他们在[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]上的基地，立即撤离并保护在那里储存的其他贵重物品。这颗可居住的卫星现在无人居住，可以被殖民。
descriptions.en:
The §YBlack Needle§! have finally realized that they were duped, discovering the holes in their closed security network.

With these vulnerabilities exposed, the pirates decided to abandon their base on [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], evacuating immediately and securing the other valuables that were stored there. This habitable moon is now unoccupied and can be colonized.

tooltips.zh: §Y[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]§!上的陆军已经离开行星。现在可以进行殖民了。
tooltips.en: Armies on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]§! have left the planet. It is now colonizable.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y黑针§!基地的废墟中找到了一个地下金库，打开后发现里面藏着他们不义之财的小型宝藏。

安全屋里存放着各种各样的贵重物品，以及与海盗组织历史相关的纪念品。我们在被盗的艺术品、个性化珠宝和加密的数字钱包中找到了星图胶囊。

我们怀疑这里的大多数赃物根本难以销赃。艺术品一看便知，珠宝需要熔化成废料，使用数字钱包进行的交易通常也可以追踪。这些物品的原主人中，有些人可能已经去世，但其他人仍在寻找他们被盗的财产。
descriptions.en:
Navigating the ruins of the §YBlack Needle§! base, we found an underground vault and opened it to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.

We suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

descriptions.zh:
我们探索了破败的§Y黑针§!基地，发现了一份设施蓝图，揭露了还有一个地下金库的存在。我们乘坐维修电梯深入地下，输入了访问代码之后，发现了一个小型宝库，里面藏着他们不义之财。

安全屋里存放着各种各样的贵重物品，以及与海盗组织历史相关的纪念品。我们在被盗的艺术品、个性化珠宝和加密的数字钱包中找到了星图胶囊。

我们怀疑这里的大多数赃物根本难以销赃。艺术品一看便知，珠宝需要熔化成废料，使用数字钱包进行的交易通常也可以追踪。这些物品的原主人中，有些人可能已经去世，但其他人仍在寻找他们被盗的财产。
descriptions.en:
Exploring the battered §YBlack Needle§! base, we found a blueprint of the facility that revealed the existence of an underground vault. Descending deep beneath the earth in a service elevator, we entered the access code to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.

The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.

We suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

label.en: Attempt to repatriate the stolen items.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功突破了数字加密层，并将新信息整合到§Y星国图志§!中。这又让我们发现了另一个值得探索的目的地，现在星图几乎完整了。我们相信只剩下最后一块拼图，并谨慎乐观地认为我们的探索即将结束。

在解码导航数据的同时，我们也认为无瑕的舱体外壳值得分析。容器的强度和耐用性令人惊讶；复制这种材料的能力可以为未来的研究提供许多潜在的机会。
descriptions.en:
We successfully overcame the layers of digital encryption and integrated new information into the §YCelestial Chart§!. This revealed yet another destination to explore and now the chart is almost complete. We believe that there is only one piece of the puzzle remaining, and are cautiously optimistic that the end of our quest is in sight.

While the navigational data was being decoded, the unblemished exterior of the capsule itself was deemed worthy of analysis. The strength and durability of the container was surprising; the ability to replicate this material could provide many potential opportunities for future research.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[FROM.GetName]发现了一个小型定居点，人口不到一千，居民是一些感性软体动物。对该物种的初步生物学分析表明，它们具有亚空间突触交流的能力，表明存在一个蜂巢思维。除了这个孤立的营地外，这颗星球上没有其他智慧生命。

也许这个物种对我们听说过的“§Y奈斯船长§!”有更多信息。

为什么我们会被§Y星国图志§!导向这里尚不清楚，需要进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
We have found a small settlement on [FROM.GetName] with a population of less than a thousand sentient molluscoids. Preliminary biological analysis of the species shows a capacity for subspace ephapse communication, indicating the existence of a hive mind. Other than this isolated encampment, the planet is uninhabited by any other sentient life.

Perhaps this species has more information on this "§YCaptain Ness§!" we have heard about.

Why the §YCelestial Chart§! has led us here is not yet clear and requires further investigation.

§H这是一个隐藏在[FROM.GetName]星系中的蜂巢思维节点，斯密吉卜不安地扭动着。他们习惯于服从，因此在被说话时会习惯性地低下头。§!

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同另一个集体意识物种交谈了。

我们叫斯密吉卜。我们很好奇你是怎么找到我们的。这个恒星系已经隐藏在星系视野之外数千年了。

只有§Y船长§!知道这个地方。你想要找什么？
descriptions.en:

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to other groupmind.

Our name is Smeegibb. We are curious how you find us. This system is hidden from galactic view for thousands of years.

Only §YThe Captain§! knows this place. You seek what?

descriptions.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]遇到的生物，斯密吉卜，透露了一个废弃的安全屋的坐标，该安全屋以前由他们和§Y奈斯船长§!居住。调查这个地点可能会让我们找到§Y星国图志§!的下一部分，或者至少是一条线索，指引我们走向正确的方向。
descriptions.en: The being we encountered on [from.GetName], Smeegibb, has revealed the coordinates of an abandoned safehouse formerly occupied by themselves and §YCaptain Ness§!. Investigating this location may lead us to the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!, or at least a clue to guide us in the right direction.

descriptions.zh:
挖掘出的建筑显示出长期使用的迹象。它曾经拥有充足的基本设施。在整个建筑中发现了零散的饰品和奇珍异宝。在一堆凌乱的纸张中，我们找到了由§Y奈斯船长§!本人写下的日志条目。

§L我们登上并劫持了另一艘佩里坎的珍宝运输船，但这次他们已经做好了准备。附带损失比我想象的要多一些，但我们解决过更糟糕的情况。不错的收益，但塔皮科宝石仍然在逃。不幸的是，现在佩里坎人又提高了赏金，联邦也介入了。现在情况有点棘手。可能需要避一避风头。§!
descriptions.en:
The excavated structure showed evidence of long periods of use. It was once well-stocked with basic amenities. Trinkets and curios have been discovered strewn throughout the building. Within a pile of messy papers, we recovered a log entry written by §YCaptain Ness§! herself.

§LWe boarded and hijacked another Perikan treasury transport, but this time they were ready for us. More collateral than I'd like, but we've handled worse. Decent payout, but the Tapico Jewel continues to elude us. Unfortunately, now the Perikans have increased their bounty again and the Federation has gotten involved. Things are a bit hot right now. Might need to lay low for a while.§!

descriptions.zh:
在结构下方的挖掘发现了一小批贵重物品和基本的卫生系统。不幸的是，在彻底搜查了该区域后，我们未能找到任何关于§Y星国图志§!碎片的痕迹。

我们收集了更多笔记本和文件，希望能从§Y奈斯船长§!散乱的日志条目中找到线索。

§L在像斯密吉卜这样的伙伴陪伴下时间过得没那么慢，但值得分享荣耀吗？当然，与一个蜂巢思维合作有难以置信的价值。用仅仅一份利润的份额换取数百个子个体的使用权？真是个好交易！但也许他们所做的工作会削弱我自己的成就……？我不确定我是否能接受分享自己遗产的想法。我需要再仔细考虑一下。§!
descriptions.en:
Digging beneath the structure revealed a small stash of valuables and basic sanitation systems. Unfortunately, after scouring the area completely, we were unable to find any evidence of a piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

We have collected more notebooks and papers in the hope of discovering a clue within §YCaptain Ness§!'s scattered log entries.

§LTime passes less slowly with a partner like Smeegibb, but is it worth splitting the glory? Sure, working with a hive mind has incredible value. Access to hundreds of drones in exchange for just a single cut of the profits? What a deal! But maybe the work they do takes away from my own achievements...? I'm not sure I can live with the idea of sharing my legacy. I'll need to give this more thought.§!

descriptions.zh:
在一个通风口里，我们发现了§Y奈斯船长§!的最后日记。

§L我不想以这种方式被记住。斯密吉卜一直是我的忠实伙伴，但不要说我需要他们。我可以独自征服星系。我会留下我的印记，荣耀将属于我。还有财富。

给自己留个笔记：最好给斯密吉卜送点东西留作纪念。§!

这就是我们能找到的全部。没有关于船长或§Y星国图志§!的任何其他线索。

也许给斯密吉卜的礼物中包含着关于最后一块碎片下落的线索。我们必须重新与他们建立联系。
descriptions.en:
Concealed within an air vent, we discovered §YCaptain Ness§!' final journal entry.

§LThis isn't how I want to be remembered. Smeegibb has been a loyal companion, but never let it be said I needed them. I can take on the galaxy solo. I'll leave MY mark, and the glory will be mine. As well as the riches.

Note to self: Better send Smeegibb something to remember me by.§!

This is all there is left to find. There is no other trace of the Captain or any sign of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

Perhaps the gift to Smeegibb that was mentioned holds some clue to the whereabouts of the final piece. We must re-open communications with them.

descriptions.zh:
我们无法重新与斯密吉卜建立通讯。由于这是我们获得§H星国图志§!下一部分的唯一线索，我们应该返回[smeegibb_system.GetName]调查情况。目前尚不清楚通讯突然中断的原因。

我希望我们新近发现的朋友还安全。
descriptions.en:
We were unable to re-establish communications with Smeegibb. As our only clue to the next piece of the §HCelestial Chart§!, we should return to [smeegibb_system.GetName] to investigate the situation. The reason behind the sudden break in contact is currently unknown.

We hope that our newfound friend is safe.

descriptions.zh:
一支印着名为§Y黑针§!的海盗组织的旗帜的庞大舰队，被发现正在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]轨道上运行。我们相信这些海盗一直在跟踪我们的行动，并且已经夷平了名为斯密吉卜的集体的居所。他们一定还在寻找§Y星国图志§!的下一部分。

该星球上没有发现任何智慧生命迹象。

我们正在接收来自他们旗舰的信号。
descriptions.en:
A sizable fleet bearing the flag of the pirate organization known as the §YBlack Needle§! has been sighted orbiting [smeegibb_shelter.GetName]. We believe that these pirates have been shadowing our movements, and have razed the settlement housing the collective known as Smeegibb. They must still be searching for the next piece of the §YCelestial Chart§!.

No signs of sentient life remain on the planet.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

titles.en: Captain Inax of the Black Needle

descriptions.zh:
§H这节肢动物昂首挺胸，复眼闪着耀眼的光芒。它严谨的姿态与不安的口器形成鲜明对比，口器不规则地咔哒作响，兴奋地颤抖着。§!

所以，我们终于见面了。你们这些软甲生物是怎么战胜§Y荷—荷—荷仁舰长§!的！？即使是那个老糊涂也应该轻而易举地消灭你们可怜的舰队。你们将为搞—搞—搞砸我们在[black_needle_base.GetName]的基地付出代价。

感—感—感谢你带我们到这里，§Y银羽§!追捕那些可怜的斯密吉卜超过一百个周期。了结他古老的怨恨意味着我将获得丰厚的赏金……在我解决了你之后。
descriptions.en:
§HThis arthopoid stands tall, its compound eyes glaring brightly. A disciplined demeanor is at odds with the fidgeting of mandibles, which irregularly click and shiver with excitement.§!

So, we finally meet. How did you softshells manage to defeat §YK-k-kaptain Hoo§!? Even that old k-k-kretin should have easily eliminated your pitiful fleet. You will pay for ransack-k-king our base on [black_needle_base.GetName].

Thank-k-k you for leading us here. §YSilver Quill§! hunted that pitiful Smeegibb for over one hundred cycles. Settling one of his ancient grudges means I'm due for a big bounty... Once I'm through with you.

descriptions.zh:
一场难忘的战斗！你并不像看起来那样弱。我们已经低估了你两次，但不会再犯同样的错误。下次我们相遇，§Y黑——黑针§!将不会手下留情。

不要把这当作警告，这是你的死刑判决。
descriptions.en:
A memorable battle! You aren't as weak-k-k as you seem. We have underestimated you twice, but no longer. The next time we meet, the §YBlack-k-k Needle§! will not be holding back.

Do not treat this as a warning. It is a death sentence.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]寻找§Y星国图志§!第四块碎片的行动已圆满结束。我们在一座石雕上发现了嵌入其中的胶囊，雕像描绘的是一个来自现已灭绝的斯密吉卜集体组织的子个体。雕像上的铭文如下：

§L“献给我的忠诚船员：这是我对你的感谢。愿你的孤独长久而平静。”§!

一旦这最后一块碎片被破译，我们就可以继续寻找§Y奈斯船长§!的宝藏。
descriptions.en:
Our search for the fourth piece of the §YCelestial Chart§! on [from.GetName] has concluded successfully. The capsule was found embedded within a stone statue of a drone from the now-extinct collective known as Smeegibb. The inscription on the statue reads as follows:

§L"To my loyal crewmate: a token of my appreciation. May your solitude be long and peaceful."§!

Once this final piece of the chart is decoded, we can continue our search for §YCaptain Ness§!' treasure.

descriptions.zh:
解码后，新的数据片段完成了我们的§Y星国图志§!。各个节点上闪烁着光点，指示着我们沿途发现的中间目的地。然后，四盏灯同时闪烁，揭示了另一个隐藏的恒星系。

添加最后一块数据解锁了额外的功能。这份§Y导航图§!不仅仅是一张简单的地图，它包含了§Y奈斯船长§!收集的关于星系中失落财富和非法珍宝的信息。一些数据可能已经过期，但该设备可以有效地检测到我们所有恒星系中隐藏的宝藏。

此外，§Y星图§!还包含了船长在其职业生涯中发现的每件珍宝的评估信息。这些详细的笔记解释了如何识别、评估和向潜在买家展示获得的贵重物品，以获得最大利润。重新激活设备将提供独特宝藏库的设计，使我们的殖民地能够利用船长的无与伦比的洞察力，为我们的宝藏增值。
descriptions.en:
Once decoded, the new data fragment completed our §YCelestial Chart§!. Points of light shone at various nodes indicating the interim destinations we have discovered along the way. The four lights then flickered in unison before revealing another hidden system.

Adding the final piece of the data has unlocked additional capabilities. The §YChart§! is not a simple map, it contains information on lost riches and illicit treasure troves across the galaxy as collected by §YCaptain Ness§!. Some of the data may have expired, but this device can feasibly detect hidden caches of valuable treasure across all of our systems.

Furthermore, the §YChart§! contains appraisal information on every treasure the Captain discovered throughout her career. These detailed notes explain how to identify, appraise, and present acquired valuables to potential sellers for maximum profit. Reactivating the device will provide designs for a unique Treasure Vault allowing our colonies to take advantage of the Captain's unparalleled insight and add value to our hoard.

descriptions.zh:
§Y星国图志§!的完成对于[this.GetName]来说是一个重大的时刻。随着所有秘密的解开，我们被指引到一个无从回避的目的地：[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]星系。

在克服了许多障碍之后，我们只差一步之遥。只有一个问题仍然存在：§Y星图§!的尽头是什么？

我们无法保证一定可以马到成功，但我们也决不容许其他人趁机夺取。让我们奋勇前进，完成这场冒险！
descriptions.en:
The completion of the §YCelestial Chart§! is a momentous occasion for [this.GetName]. With all its secrets unlocked, we are pointed to one inescapable destination: the [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName] system.

After overcoming many obstacles, we are but one step away. Only one question remains: what lies at the end of the §YChart§!?

There is no guarantee of success, but we would not have it any other way. Let us strike forth to see this adventure through!

descriptions.zh:
随着[from.GetName]上的珍宝馆的建立，我们相信§Y星国图志§!有潜力为我们的经济做出重大贡献。

为了充分利用§Y星图§!的能力，我们设立了一个新的内阁职位，专门负责领导我们发现和收集宝藏的行动。
descriptions.en:
With the establishment of the Treasure Vault on [from.GetName], we believe that the §YCelestial Chart§! has the potential to contribute significantly to our economy.

In order to best take advantage of the §YChart§!'s capabilities, we have conceived a new Council position for an individual to lead our efforts in discovering and gathering treasure.

descriptions.zh:
地图将我们带到一个以前未探明的黑洞，以及一个被虚空虫寄生的恒星系。它们在附近一座废弃的星门安家，其中最大的几只像守护者一样绕着这处废弃的建筑盘旋。

这一定就是通往我们梦寐以求宝藏的那道星门。如果我们要到达路线的终点，必须消灭虚空虫并修复星门。
descriptions.en:
The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with Voidworms. Having taken up nest in a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.

It must be this Gateway that will lead us to our long-sought treasure. If we are to reach the trail's end, we must eliminate the Voidworms and repair the Gate.

descriptions.zh:
地图将我们带到一个以前未探明到的黑洞，以及一个充满奇怪生物的恒星系。这些生物聚集在一个废弃星门的附近，其中最大的生物绕着这个废弃的结构盘旋，仿佛占领了此处。

这些巨大的虫状生物不在我们关于太空兽群的数据库中。我们目前正在尝试建立通信。这一定就是通往我们梦寐以求宝藏的那道星门。如果我们要到达轨迹的尽头，我们必须处理这些生物并修复星门。
descriptions.en:
The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with strange creatures. Having gathered around a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.

These massive worm-like entities are not present in our databases of spaceborne fauna. We are currently attempting to establish communications. It must be this Gateway that will lead us to our long-sought treasure. If we are to reach the trail's end, we must deal with these creatures and repair the Gate.

label.zh: 什么都不能挡我们的道。
label.en: Nothing will stand in our way.

label.zh: 如果我们必须这样做的话。

descriptions.zh:
在一具虚空虫的尸体中，发现了一群刚刚孵化的若虫。尽管它们的同类遭受了屠戮，但它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始与我们的舰队并肩漂浮，以示恳求。

如果我们愿意，可以利用它们对我们的本能依恋：一旦成熟，这群太空生物将成为我们控制下的一支强大的有机舰队。
descriptions.en:
A clutch of nymphs were found nestled within one of the Voidworm carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.

If we so choose, we could use their instinctive attachment to our advantage: once matured, this clutch of spaceborne creatures could become an impressive organic fleet under our control.

descriptions.zh:
在一具蛇形生物的残骸中，发现了一窝幼崽。尽管它们的同类遭受了损失，它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始在我们的舰队旁边漂浮，以示臣服。

如果我们愿意，可以利用它们对我们的本能依恋：一旦成熟，这群太空生物将成为我们控制下的一支强大的有机舰队。
descriptions.en:
A clutch of younglings were found nestled within one of the serpentine carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.

If we so choose, we could use their instinctive attachment to our advantage: once matured, this clutch of spaceborne creatures could become an impressive organic fleet under our control.

descriptions.zh:
我们被跟踪了。

现在，我们在[ness_treasure_system.GetName]遭遇了一支强大的§Y黑针§!舰队。与我们上次遭遇相比，他们的队伍规模显著扩大，包括退役的军舰和改装了高级武器的民用船只。看来他们已经集结了大部分预备舰队来应对这次对抗。舰队中央是他们的旗舰，一艘巨大的泰坦级战舰。

虽然他们的编队已做好战斗准备，但大多数舰船尚未启动武器。看来他们打算谈判。

我们正在接收来自旗舰的通讯。
descriptions.en:
We were followed.

We are now confronted by an imposing §YBlack Needle§! fleet in [ness_treasure_system.GetName]. In comparison to our last encounter, their ranks have swelled significantly to include decommissioned military ships and civilian vessels retrofitted with high-grade armaments. It appears that they have assembled the bulk of their reserve fleets for this confrontation. At the center of the fleet lies their flagship, a massive Titan class vessel.

While their formation is battle-ready, most ships have not yet primed their weapons. It seems they intend to negotiate.

We are receiving a transmission from the flagship.

titles.en: Cobalt Quill, Captain of the Black Needle

descriptions.zh:
§H尽管身材矮小，这位海盗船长却散发着威严。他的眼睛在盘算着，仿佛在解一道复杂的方程式，将我们仔细评估。§!

终于见面了。钴羽，§Y黑针§!号船长，我们家族的荣耀，也是银羽创始人的后裔，向您致敬！您多年来一直是我们的一根刺——但我还是讲道理的。我带着一个提议而来。

我们会为您的完整星图支付丰厚的赏金，并允许您带着你们无足轻重的性命离开。

如果您拒绝，我们将别无选择，只能强行夺取我们想要的东西。我们的海军实力占优，并且我们也渗透了您帝国的所有关键设施。只要我一声令下，您就会彻底崩溃。
descriptions.en:
§HDespite his small stature, this pirate captain emanates gravitas. His eyes are calculating, weighing us up as if part of a complex equation.§!

At last we finally meet. Cobalt Quill at your service; Captain of the illustrious §YBlack Needle§! and humble descendant of our founder, Silver Quill. You have been a thorn in my side for a great many years - but I'm reasonable if nothing else. I come to you with an offer.

We will give you a significant bounty for your completed chart and allow you to leave with your meaningless lives intact.

If you refuse, we will have no choice but to take what we want by force. Our naval superiority notwithstanding, we have also infiltrated every place you hold dear. A single command of mine is all that keeps you from total ruin.

label.zh: 何必多此一举和我们谈判？
这不仅仅是钱的问题，对吧？
label.en: This isn't just about the credits, is it?

descriptions.zh:
§Y黑针§!的首领提出了一项提议，他们愿意支付巨额赏金来换取§Y星国图志§!。如果我们接受了这个交易，就等于将§Y奈斯船长§!宝藏的关键拱手相让。

拒绝他们的提议将会招致他们的怒火。这些海盗渗透到我们军队序列中的程度尚不清楚，但他们威胁要从内部彻底瓦解[this.GetName]。这些威胁是否只是虚张声势，还有待观察。
descriptions.en:
The leader of the §YBlack Needle§! has made a proposition, offering us a significant bounty in exchange for the §YCelestial Chart§!. If we took this deal, we would be handing over the key to §YCaptain Ness§!'s treasure.

Rejecting this proposal will invoke their full wrath. The extent to which these pirates have infiltrated our ranks is unknown, but they have threatened to completely dismantle [this.GetName] from the inside out. Whether these are but empty threats remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh:
我们以一笔巨额能量币和一艘名为§Y针眼§!的非凡军舰作为报酬，给出了§Y星国图志§!。我们可以认为我们与§Y黑针§!的争端已彻底解决。

我们避免了与他们全部舰队进行重大交战，并阻止了一次对星系规模的蓄意破坏企图。

最好还是让海盗们继续做他们的海盗勾当。
descriptions.en:
We handed over the §YCelestial Chart§! in exchange for a large sum of Energy Credits and an exceptional military flagship known as §YThe Eye of the Needle§!. We can consider our dispute with the §YBlack Needle§! to be settled once and for all.

We have avoided a significant engagement with the full force of their fleets and prevented a sabotage attempt on a galactic scale.

Better that we simply leave piracy to the pirates.

descriptions.zh:
§Y黑针§!发起了全面攻击，给我们带来影响广泛的混乱。生产线停产，发电机烧毁，重要的行政基础设施被迫下线。货物消失，研究站的数据被清空，矿井坍塌速度是正常速度的五倍。

这场全方位的破坏是数千名歹毒的参与者协同作案的结果。一个庞大的破坏者网络潜伏在我们之中，他们似乎总是领先我们一步。
descriptions.en:
The §YBlack Needle§! has launched an all-out assault, unleashing widespread chaos. Assembly lines have ground to a halt, generators have burnt out, and essential administrative infrastructure has been taken offline. Shipments are disappearing, research stations have had their data wiped, and mines are collapsing at five times the typical rate.

The devastation is total; the result of insidious handiwork of thousands of malevolent actors working in tandem. A vast network of saboteurs is hidden among us and they seem to be one step ahead of us.

descriptions.zh:
我们截获了§Y黑针§!在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

他们的特工一直秘密地在我们的操作系统中传播恶意软件，制造了一个由叛乱单位构成的休眠军队，潜伏在我们系统各个位置。

这个歹毒的重新编程计划已经走得如此之远，以至于腐化了[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en:
We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the §YBlack Needle§! throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

Their operatives have been covertly spreading insidious malware within our operating systems, creating a sleeper army of rebel units occupying various positions across our systems.

The malicious reprogramming scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们截获了§Y黑针§!在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

他们的特工一直在居住地释放分离性信息素，导致我们许多工蜂产生了潜在的偏差。一旦被迷惑住，海盗们将我们的工蜂重新安置到休眠特工的舱室，他们目前正在破坏我们的基础设施。

这个庞大的计划已经发展到腐蚀[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en:
We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the §YBlack Needle§! throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

Their operatives have been flooding habitats with dissociative pheromones, causing many of our drones to develop an underlying deviance. Once disillusioned, the pirates reorganized our drones into pods of sleeper agents who are currently tearing down our infrastructure.

The extensive scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们截获了§Y黑针§!在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。

我们已经得知他们的特工多年来一直在招募心怀不满的公民，为这次大规模袭击做准备，他们利用潜伏的间谍网络和各种随时准备背叛我们的线人。

其中一名叛徒已暴露，正是§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!，这构成了重大的安全风险。我们必须处理这个阴谋家，同时保持一定程度的稳定。公众得知这种程度的腐败将对我们的政府造成严重后果。
descriptions.en:
We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the §YBlack Needle§! throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

We have learned their operatives have been recruiting disgruntled citizens for years, preparing for this extensive attack with sleeper cells and a variety of assets ready to turn against us.

One of the traitors has been revealed to be §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!, which presents a considerable security risk. We must deal with this conspirator while maintaining some sense of stability. Public knowledge of this level of corruption would have serious repercussions for our government.

descriptions.zh:
继发现[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]效忠于§Y黑针§!海盗之后，[traitor_leader.GetHeShe]发布了一份公开声明，对[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的行为表示深深的悔恨。这场磨难似乎对[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的领导能力产生了持久的影响。

尽管过去犯下种种错误，但[root.GetName]的人民似乎愿意原谅[traitor_leader.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
Following the discovery of [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] allegiance to the §YBlack Needle§! pirates, [traitor_leader.GetHeShe] released a public statement expressing a deep regret for [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] actions. This ordeal seems to have left a lasting effect on [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] ability to lead.

Despite their past deeds, it seems like the people of [root.GetName] are willing to forgive [traitor_leader.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
不幸的是，我们无法阻止§Y黑针§!的破坏行动。他们的破坏者已经彻底破坏了我们的后勤基础设施，重建供应链将需要数年时间。他们在我们的恒星系中传播的腐败规模太大，无法得到缓解。

然而，这不会阻止我们以我们的名义夺取§Y奈斯船长的宝藏§!。我们只需要在战斗中击败海盗，宝藏就会属于我们。
descriptions.en:
Unfortunately, we were unable to thwart the devastating operations of §YBlack Needle§!. Their saboteurs have damaged our logistics infrastructure beyond repair, and it will take many years to rebuild our supply chains. The corruption they've spread throughout our systems is on too grand of a scale to be mitigated.

However, this will not stop us from claiming §YCaptain Ness's Hoard§! in our name. All that we must do is defeat the pirates in battle, and the treasure will be ours.

descriptions.zh: 尽管§Y黑针§!竭尽全力破坏我们的基础设施，我们依然得到恢复并稳定了局势。他们的特工已被击败，剩下的就是与他们在[hoard_system.GetName]集结的舰队对抗，并以[root.GetName]的名义夺取§Y奈斯船长的宝藏§!。
descriptions.en: Despite the extensive efforts of the §YBlack Needle§! to sabotage our infrastructure, we have recovered and stabilized. With their agents defeated, all that remains is to confront their amassed fleet in [hoard_system.GetName] and claim §YCaptain Ness's Hoard§! in the name of [root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: §Y黑针§!的军力根本无法与我们强大的军队抗衡。他们集结的舰队已被击败，无法再支持对我们恒星系的破坏行动。现在，我们可以在[root.GetName]的名义下夺取§Y奈斯船长的宝藏§!。
descriptions.en: The §YBlack Needle§! could simply not compete with the might of our military. With their amassed fleets defeated, they can no longer support the sabotage efforts within our systems. We are now free to claim §YCaptain Ness's Hoard§! in the name of [root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
奈斯的孩子们……真是讽刺。

是她选择了你——你知道吗？

数百种物种任她挑选……她却选择了你。也许她看到了你身上的特别之处，也许这只是一场纯粹的偶然。无论如何，我们都走到了这一步。

你赢了……暂时。不要轻视这场胜利。你已经树立了强大的敌人——我们，§Y黑针§!我们不会宽恕，也不会忘记。

就像我的祖先一样，我们会坚持下去。我们会一点一点地重建我们失去的一切。即使需要一千年，一百万年——我们也会回来，夺回你从我们手中夺走的一切。

黑针将永远存在！永远！
descriptions.en:
Ness's children... how ironic.

She chose you - do you know that?

Hundreds of species to choose from... and she chose you. Maybe she saw something special in you, or maybe it was complete chance. Either way, here we are.

You win... for now. Do not dare take this victory lightly. You have made a powerful enemy in us. The §YBlack Needle§! does not forgive, and we do not forget.

As my ancestors did before me, we will persevere. We will rebuild what we have lost piece by piece. Even if it takes a thousand years, a million years - we will return and reclaim everything you have stolen from us.

The Black Needle will live on forever! Forever!

descriptions.zh:
§Y星国图志§!是钥匙，而宝库是它的锁。我们把它插入巨型结构的主舱口。

星图启动，内部追踪着一道单一的的光束，指向我们旅程中经过的每一颗恒星。古老的机器发出咯吱咯吱的响声，我们很快便进入了内部。

来自一千个世界的难以置信的宝藏，在地板和墙壁上堆积如山。精致的雕像与用贵金属打造的攻击武器并列。精美的珠宝悬挂在古老化石的末端，复杂的装置堆积成一堆，毫无秩序。

金属的脚步声从中央走道传来。一只充满液体的类人生物机器，举起双臂投降，向我们走来。它的语音电路发出噼啪声，启动了：

§L“所以……你最终还是找到了我的星图。你真聪明。”§!
descriptions.en:
The §YCelestial Chart§! was a key, and the vault was its lock. We inserted it into the main hatch of the megastructure.

The chart activated, internally tracing a singular beam of light to each star along our journey. Ancient machinery groaned to life, and we were soon inside.

Incredible treasures looted from a thousand worlds line the floor and walls in abundance. Delicate statues are juxtaposed against assault weapons forged in precious metals. Fine jewelry hangs from the extremities of antique fossils and complex devices are piled up in an orderless heap.

Metallic footsteps ring out from the central walkway. Arms raised in surrender, a fluid-filled humanoid machine approaches us. Its voice circuits crackle into activation:

§L"So... you found my chart after all. Aren't you clever?"§!

descriptions.zh:
§H尽管她的机械形态限制了其表达能力，但被称为奈斯船长的机器却用一种自鸣得意的眼神看着我们。她的金属身体没有丝毫磨损的迹象，仿佛刚组装不久。她的语气既耐心又居高临下，仿佛在对一个地位低于她的人说话。§!

我想应该做个自我介绍，尽管你可能已经猜到我是谁了。

我叫桑达·奈斯，或者至少以前是。曾经的“星海海盗女王”，现在是这堆冰冷螺栓的主人。

§H机器停顿了一下，观察着我们的形态。§!

我已经很久没有见过你们这种生物了。看起来你们这些原始人已经长大成人了！

我必须说，我对你们能来到这里感到非常惊讶。
descriptions.en:
§HDespite the limited expressions available in her robotic form, the machine known as Captain Ness regards us with a certain smugness. Her metallic body shows no sign of wear and tear, as if only recently assembled. Her tone is patient yet patronizing, as if addressing one below her status.§!

I suppose some introduction is in order, though you may already have guessed who I am.

The name's Saanda Ness, or at least it was. Former "Pirate Queen of the Galaxy" and current occupant of this cold pile of bolts.

§HThe machine pauses for a moment, taking in our forms.§!

It's been a long time since I last saw your species. Looks like you primitives are all grown up!

I must say, I'm quite impressed you've made it here.

descriptions.zh:
§Y奈斯船长的宝藏§!包含着难以置信的财富。然而，我们必须考虑以我们的名义宣称它所带来的后果。

她宝藏中的每一笔信用都是非法获得的。获取这些资源将意味着我们容忍奈斯船长的过度犯罪行为，以换取物质财富。

话虽如此，许多被奈斯船长伤害的人早已不在人世。宣称这笔财富不会造成新的受害者。此外，我们已经消灭了§Y黑针§!，从而使星系变得更加安全。经过漫长的危险旅程，我们理所当然地应该得到丰厚的回报。

我们必须决定如何处理它。
descriptions.en:
§YCaptain Ness's Hoard§! contains an incredible bounty of wealth. We must however consider the consequences of claiming it in our name.

Every credit of her treasure was earned illegally. Taking these resources would represent a tolerance of Captain Ness's excessive criminality in exchange for material wealth.

That said, many of those wronged by Captain Ness are long gone. Claiming this wealth would create no new victims. Furthermore, we have decimated the §YBlack Needle§! and thus made the galaxy a safer place. Having traveled this long path fraught with danger, we arguably deserve a sizable reward for our efforts.

We must make a decision on what to do with its contents.

descriptions.zh:
§Y奈斯船长的宝藏§!是终极的藏宝地，我们很高兴能获得它的战利品。

这是打败了§Y黑针§!的应得奖励——为[this.GetName]三呼万岁！

让我们清理这个金库。所有[This.Species.GetHandNamePlural]准备就位！
descriptions.en:
§YCaptain Ness's Hoard§! is the ultimate treasure trove, and we are pleased to claim its booty.

A hard-earned reward for taking down the §YBlack Needle§! - three cheers for [this.GetName]!

Let's clear out this vault. All [This.Species.GetHandNamePlural] on deck!

将可以溯源的物品归还给其合法所有者。
label.en: Return traceable items to their rightful owners.

descriptions.zh:
§H现在被称为§Y奈斯船长§!的机器对我们清空她的珍宝库的速度印象深刻。§!

去吧，你应得的。这笔财富里包含着许多血汗和泪水。别在一个地方花光了。
descriptions.en:
§HThe machine now known as §YCaptain Ness§! was impressed at how quickly we emptied her vault.§!

Go ahead, you deserve it. There's a lot of blood, sweat, and tears in this treasure. Don't spend it all in one place.

descriptions.zh:
§H现在被称为§Y奈斯船长§!的机器对我们想要归还她辛苦赚来的宝藏感到不安。§!

真是令人失望。所以某个第十五代继承人会得到他们祖先的旧首饰。好吧，希望你们能把剩下的东西用在更有价值的项目上。尽管你们最近干了些蠢事，但我相信你们会把这件事做好。
descriptions.en:
§HThe machine now known as §YCaptain Ness§! was perturbed at our desire to repatriate some of her hard-earned treasure.§!

How disappointing. So some fifteenth-generation heirling will get their ancestor's old jewelry. Well, hopefully you'll use whatever's left on a worthier project. Despite recent evidence, I trust you to get this right.

descriptions.zh:
§H现在被称为§Y奈斯船长§!的机器得知我们要把她的全部积蓄都送出去，感到十分厌恶。§!

这就是你的计划？免费送给所有人？他们做了什么值得得到这些？真是浪费！

我对你原本抱有更高的期望……至少让我指挥一些你的舰队，让我可以再试一次曾经的海盗生涯。
descriptions.en:
§HThe machine now known as §YCaptain Ness§! was disgusted when she learned that we would be giving away her entire hoard.§!

This is your master plan? Free stuff for everyone? What did they do to deserve any of it? What a waste!

I thought better of you... at least give me command of some of your fleets so I can try this all over again.

descriptions.zh: §H现在的问题是该如何处理奈斯船长本人。作为一名经验丰富的舰船驾驶员，她经历过无数危险遭遇，将成为我们军队中优秀的指挥官。或者，她也可以在我们队伍中担任更具保障性的角色，培训下一代飞行员。§!
descriptions.en: §HThe question remains of what to do with Captain Ness herself. As an experienced pilot who has survived a multitude of dangerous encounters, she would be an excellent asset to our military as a Commander. Alternatively, she could take a more supporting role within our ranks to train our next generation of pilots.§!

descriptions.zh: §H或者我们也可以她关起来，以此向我们的公民表明，任何罪行都不会逍遥法外。她将有足够的时间反思自己的所作所为。§!
descriptions.en: §HThat is unless we simply incarcerate her to set an example to our citizens that no crime goes unpunished. She would have a long time to think about what she's done.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H唯一剩下的决定是关于奈斯船长本人。作为一名强大的独立思想者，她可以成为一名独特的指挥官，提供出敌不意的创意策略。或者，我们可以将她的丰富战斗经验融入我们的集体知识中，并利用它来进一步加深我们对战争的理解。

或者我们也可以干脆将她囚禁起来，以表明在[this.GetName]中不容忍背叛和犯罪行为。§!
descriptions.en:
§HThe only remaining decision is to do with Captain Ness herself. As a powerful independent mind, she would make for a unique asset in a Commander role, offering creative strategies that could catch opponents off-guard. Alternatively, we could integrate her vast combat experience into our collective knowledge and use it to further our wider understanding of warfare.

That is unless we simply imprison her to make it clear that deviance and criminality are not to be tolerated within [this.GetName].§!

label.zh: §Y我们将把你的知识融入我们的意识。§!
label.en: §YWe will integrate your knowledge into our consciousness.§!
§YHelp us in training our new pilots.§!

label.zh: 我们可以让你担任一名舰队指战员。
label.en: We could use you as a pilot.

tooltips.zh: 获得一位等级10的§Y不朽舰队司令§!

descriptions.zh:
就这样了？

你只是把我抛弃了？

真令人失望……我想我该走了。

祝你好运，我想。
descriptions.en:
That's it, then?

You're just casting me aside?

How disappointing... I guess I'll be on my way.

Good luck out there, I guess.

descriptions.zh:
你这个脑袋空空的傻屌！我给你整个世界，你却只给我一副新的镣铐？你不配得到我给你的东西！你甚至不配为我擦靴子！

愿这[this.GetName]上留下一块黑斑，诅咒你们所有人！

愿你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]在虚空中枯萎，愿你们的名字被人遗忘。
descriptions.en:
You empty-minded echo! I offer you the world and all I get is a fresh pair of cuffs? You don't deserve what I've given you! You don't deserve to clean my boots!

A black spot on the [this.GetName], a curse upon you all!

May your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] wither in the void and and your name be forgotten.

descriptions.zh:
名为§Y奈斯船长§!的机器俘虏被发现在她的牢房里停机。我们相信她故意导致了电路的严重故障，关闭了关键系统，并从她转移的意识中删除了所有存储的数据。在她牢房的墙壁上发现了一条潦草的留言：

§L与你同归于尽……§!
descriptions.en:
The captive machine known as §YCaptain Ness§! was found deactivated in her cell. We believe that she had purposely caused a critical malfunction in her circuits, shutting down crucial systems and erasing all stored data from her transferred consciousness. A message was found scribbled on her cell walls:

§LTo the void with you...§!

descriptions.zh:
他们会怎样讲述这段冒险故事！我们发现了奈斯船长的隐藏宝藏，没有人能阻挡我们。

现在是时候开创自己的命运了。没有星图可循，星辰将成为我们的指引。

我们将取得什么成就？我们将如何被铭记？

高高地挂起[this.GetName]的旗帜，现在我们的故事才真正开始！
descriptions.en:
What tales they will tell of this adventure! We discovered the hidden treasure of Captain Ness and let no crew stand in our way.

Now it is time to forge our own destiny. With no chart left to follow, the stars themselves will be our guide.

What will we achieve? How will we be remembered?

Mount the jack of [this.GetName] high and proud. Now our story truly begins!

descriptions.zh:
这场冒险已经结束。寻找§H船长奈斯§!的宝藏的任务已经完成。

现在是时候开创自己的命运了。没有星图可循，星辰将成为我们的指引。

我们将取得什么成就？我们将如何被铭记？

这才是[this.GetName]故事的真正开始。
descriptions.en:
This adventure has come to an end. The quest for the Treasure of §HCaptain Ness§! is complete.

Now it is time to forge our own destiny. With no chart left to follow, the stars themselves will be our guide.

What will we achieve? How will we be remembered?

This is where the story of [this.GetName] truly begins.
